name: Merit Interactive Co.,Ltd.
summary: Merit Interactive Co.,Ltd. operates as a professional data intelligent service provider in China. It provides push messaging, overseas push, AI application workshop, one-click authentication, and visual intelligent tools, as well as marketing data panel and population data tools. The company also operates user insight and data analysis platforms, as well as message centers. In addition, it offers data platform solutions; internet growth, brand marketing, urban governance, big data-driven precision publicity, digitalization of banks, intelligent risk control, and science and technology philanthropy solutions; and personalized intelligent workstation AI solutions.
